vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Quiet birds. I'll add it to the list of things that mean something."
"Don't suppose you've got food," A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says, trying for casual and missing.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Carolina, Victor, Tolga and Luciano met them at the door — 4 put down. Carolina, Victor, Tolga, Luciano are hurt.
🛡️ Carolina, Tolga, Brian and Xavier met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Carolina, Tolga, Brian, Xavier are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Carolina, Xavier, Owen and Quinn met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Carolina, Xavier, Owen, Quinn are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Brian just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carolina, Tolga and Brian met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Carolina, Tolga, Brian are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Owen just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sigrun just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tolga just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cristina just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl and Cristina met them at the door — 2 put down. Vasyl is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cristina just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
